questions.q: What does a data export actually produce?
options: A live, syncing replica of the org
A single Excel workbook with one tab per object
A set of CSV files, one per exported object
A compressed database backup file (.bak)
questions.explain: The Data Export Service generates a set of flat CSV files — one per object — available for download for 48 hours.

questions.q: What does "Include all data" control on the export options screen?
options: Whether Chatter posts are exported
Whether field history is included
Whether the file is compressed before download
Whether the export includes every object you have access to, versus just a chosen subset
questions.explain: Checking Include all data exports everything for a full backup; deselecting it lets you choose specific objects, producing a smaller, faster export.

questions.q: What does it mean that a data export is "flattened"?
options: Relationships between records export as ID columns rather than nested or joined data
All picklist values are converted to plain text
Record ownership information is stripped out
Every object is merged into a single CSV file
questions.explain: Each object exports as its own flat CSV, and relationships show up as ID columns (like a Contact's AccountId) rather than nested records — reconstructing the relationship means matching IDs across files.

questions.q: How would you restore data from a Data Export Service export if you needed to?
options: Restores are automatic and require no action
Click a single "Restore" button on the Data Export page
Contact Salesforce support, since restores can't be self-service
Reload the exported CSV files back into Salesforce using Data Loader
questions.explain: An export is a snapshot, not a restore package — getting data back in means loading the CSVs back in with Data Loader, the same as any other load.

questions.q: When is Export Now the better choice over Schedule Export?
options: When you need a one-time snapshot right before a risky change, like a mass delete
There is no difference between the two options
Export Now is only available in Developer Edition orgs
When you want the export to run automatically every week going forward
questions.explain: Export Now runs immediately and once — ideal as a safety net right before a risky operation. Schedule Export is for ongoing, recurring backups instead.
